entries.title: Dido And Aeneas
entries.finding: Five cached alternatives inspected. Saland omits required Schwarzkopf/Jones credits; the finer Warner/Naxos studio candidates retain the named cast but do not establish where source Act2FirstPart ends and Conclusion begins. The five-track reissue has two scenes, not verified LP-side boundaries. The live alternative has a different cast, including no source Schwarzkopf evidence. Existing single-vocal-work review supports specific Otello/Passion forms, not this four-band source; no cut, scene/side equivalence or new adapter is invented.
